title: Regular ordinary quotient tower equals the positive principal derived quotient tower
statement: Let ell be prime, W a scheme, O a simultaneous ordinary ell^(n+1)-cokernel presentation [def-sfb-diagonal-system-interface], e an additive equivalence from integral abelian sheaves on W to sheaves of modules over the lifted integers, and P an arbitrary unbounded complex with positive ell-power multiplication monic in every degree. Put X=O(P), K=e(QP), and let G_n=K derived-tensored with Z/ell^n, with its canonical reduction cone. There exists one isomorphism of towers alpha from n |-> e(Q(X_n)) to n |-> G_(n+1) such that e(Q of the ordinary quotient projection) followed by alpha_n equals the canonical principal reduction map from K. No inverse-limit or Milnor assertion occurs in this statement.

proof.text: The image of the prime ell in the lifted integers is a non-zero-divisor: transport to the integers by ULift.ringEquiv and use that a prime natural number has nonzero image in the integral domain of integers.

Apply the fully proved regular quotient presentation tower theorem with the pro-etale site of W, coefficient ring the lifted integers, the specified presentation O and equivalence e, and the given degreewise monicity of P. The two notations for the induced functor on derived categories are definitionally equal. This gives the tower isomorphism and its augmentation equation with no hypothesis change.

lean.statement:
theorem integral_regular_quotient_tower (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (W : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (DiagonalAb W)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ DiagonalAb W)]
    (O : DiagonalReductionPresentation ℓ (𝟭 (DiagonalAb W)))
    (e : DiagonalAb W ≌
      Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology W) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} ℤ)))
    [e.functor.Additive] [e.inverse.Additive]
    (P : CochainComplex (DiagonalAb W) ℤ)
    (hP : ∀ (n : ℕ) (i : ℤ), Mono (ℓ ^ (n + 1) • 𝟙 (P.X i))) :
    let K := e.mapDerivedCategory.functor.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)
    let X := (O.E.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P
    let G := DerivedCategory.derivedCompletionDiagram (Scheme.ProEt.topology W)
      (Ideal.span {(ℓ : ULift.{u + 1} ℤ)}) K
    ∃ α : X.asFunctor ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ e.mapDerivedCategory.functor ≅
        addOpFunctor 1 ⋙ G,
      ∀ n : ℕ,
        e.mapDerivedCategory.functor.map
            (DerivedCategory.Q.map ((NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex (O.π n) (.up ℤ)).app P)) ≫
          α.hom.app (op n) =
        (DerivedCategory.derivedCompletionCone (Scheme.ProEt.topology W)
          (Ideal.span {(ℓ : ULift.{u + 1} ℤ)}) K).π.app (op (n + 1))
